desc:
⚽ Take charge of a club and build a football dynasty. Every decision is yours, from the tactics board to the transfer market.

📋 THE GAME
- Build your formation on the tactical pitch and set player roles and set piece takers
- Watch matches live with commentary and make touchline subs
- Face the press before games and keep squad morale high

💼 BUILD YOUR SQUAD
- Negotiate transfers and contracts while keeping the board happy
- Develop wonderkids in your youth academy
- Hire coaches, scouts and physios

🏆 CHASE GLORY
- Win league titles, domestic cups and continental trophies
- Earn a reputation and get job offers from bigger clubs, or get sacked

💰 Join the group for +10% transfer and wage budgets!

🛠️ Still in beta, so you may run into some bugs. Let us know what you find!
